video_title: Finals, trades & KAT | The Jon Krawczynski Show

quotes.speaker: Jim Souhan
quotes.summary_phrase: Potential for an unconventional center-heavy NBA Finals matchup
quotes.excerpt: We might see a finals with two guys who are seven foot, shooting 25 foot shots.

text_blocks.speaker: Jim Souhan
text_blocks.text: Karl-Anthony Towns is in the finals against another very unconventional center. We might see a finals with two guys who are seven foot, shooting 25 foot shots, maybe not venturing into the paint on offense all that often. It is going to be fascinating. I don't know that Karl-Anthony Towns and Victor Wembanyama are even going to cover each other a little bit in this series.

text_blocks.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
text_blocks.text: It is going to be really fun to watch that way, Jim, because you are right. You would look at this and say, okay, it is Karl-Anthony Towns versus Victor Wembanyama on both ends, and a seven footer against a seven-six guy go at it.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Blueprint for success against Victor Wembanyama involves physical play
quotes.excerpt: If there is a blueprint to having even a modicum of success against Victor Wembanyama, a lot of teams have done it with smaller, burly dudes.

text_blocks.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
text_blocks.text: I do think that you will see Karl-Anthony Towns guarded a lot by Stefan Castle or a smaller player on the Spurs, because Karl will try to drag Victor Wembanyama out of the paint. On the other end, you will see maybe Josh Hart, maybe O.G. Anunoby, maybe a bunch of other guys on Victor Wembanyama, because it does seem like if there is a blueprint to having even a modicum of success against Victor Wembanyama, a lot of teams have done it with smaller, burly dudes that can get physical with him. Even the Wolves with Julius Randle, who is not small, but smaller than a center, is probably who had the most success against Victor Wembanyama.

text_blocks.speaker: Jim Souhan
text_blocks.text: How they go about the chess match of trying to make the other side uncomfortable is going to be key.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns must increase three-point volume against Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: I think this is a series where he is going to have to put up six, seven in a game and really try to be a threat from out there.

text_blocks.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
text_blocks.text: I do think that we have seen Karl-Anthony Towns not shoot as many threes since he has been with the Knicks. I think this is a series where he is going to have to put up six, seven in a game and really try to be a threat from out there, because Victor Wembanyama is going to be lurking near the paint and that is going to be a lot harder to get things done around the rim.

text_blocks.speaker: Jim Souhan
text_blocks.text: The Knicks are going to have to shoot the ball really well from the perimeter, which they can do, to have success in this series.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns' transformation into a point center
quotes.excerpt: He went to Mike Brown and said, hey, what if I kind of run the offense? What if we use my passing skills?

text_blocks.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
text_blocks.text: I am also fascinated by Karl-Anthony Towns' transformation into a point center. If I understand the story correctly, he went to Mike Brown and said, hey, what if I kind of run the offense? What if we use my passing skills? And it has worked brilliantly.

text_blocks.speaker: Jim Souhan
text_blocks.text: Certainly when he was in Minnesota, he was incredibly productive. He was just a different kind of player, and I do think one of the underlooked analyses of his game is how adaptable he has been.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns and Mike Brown's evolving synergy
quotes.excerpt: There was a meeting of the minds with Mike Brown and the Knicks this season.

text_blocks.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
text_blocks.text: There was a meeting of the minds with Mike Brown and the Knicks this season, because you heard early on in the year that Karl-Anthony Towns and Mike Brown were having a hard time finding a symmetry. Ultimately, Karl has molded his game to fit this free-flowing but pass-heavy offense, and one of the ways he does that is by using his passing skills.

text_blocks.speaker: Jim Souhan
text_blocks.text: The critical key to that, Karl has always been a good passer, but he has to be a more precise passer. We saw a lot of times in Minnesota, he could make real plays, but then twice a game he'd throw it over his head and it would go into the second row.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Addressing the 'whisper campaign' against Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.excerpt: I always felt like there was kind of a whisper campaign against Karl-Anthony Towns that maybe was a little phony.

text_blocks.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
text_blocks.text: I always felt like there was kind of a whisper campaign against Karl-Anthony Towns that maybe was a little phony. What we saw when he put on a good show in front of the cameras wasn't the way it necessarily was behind the scenes. I always heard the whisper campaign and I always looked for signs that it might be true, and I never came across any actual evidence that it was true.

text_blocks.speaker: Jim Souhan
text_blocks.text: I think that a lot of that is certainly true. He is judged quite a bit throughout his career, and one thing that invites that sort of scrutiny is it is clear he is one of those players who, when he does interviews, sometimes it comes across as if he is saying what he thinks you want him to say.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards' genuine nature versus media perception
quotes.excerpt: The thing that we talk about with Anthony Edwards all the time is just how genuine he is.

text_blocks.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
text_blocks.text: The thing that we talk about with Anthony Edwards all the time is just how genuine he is and how real he is, in front of a camera, off camera. There were times here in Minnesota where he felt a pressure to be the face of the franchise, and especially in times where the Timberwolves were really struggling, and he felt an obligation to try to project an image that maybe wasn't always 100 percent what he was really feeling.

text_blocks.speaker: Jim Souhan
text_blocks.text: I always looked at that as an endearing thing. He was searching for the voice, the means of communication, the way to connect with everyone.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Anticipating significant roster changes for the Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: I do think there is going to be some sort of fairly significant roster change.

text_blocks.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
text_blocks.text: What I think is going to happen is I do think there is going to be some sort of fairly significant roster change, so that the starting lineup on opening night next season is not going to be the same starting lineup that finished this season.

text_blocks.speaker: Jim Souhan
text_blocks.text: As of right now, we are in sort of this dormant period of trade talks for the league. Once the finals are over, then the draft is right around the corner, and that is when you really see a lot of conversations pick up in intensity.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Hypothetical trade scenarios involving Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: If the Wolves were talking to the Bucks about Giannis Antetokounmpo right now, I would expect that John Horst and the Bucks are saying, yeah, we'll do Giannis for Anthony Edwards.

text_blocks.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
text_blocks.text: If the Wolves were talking to the Bucks about Giannis Antetokounmpo right now, I would expect that John Horst and the Bucks are saying, yeah, we'll do Giannis for Anthony Edwards, or Tim Connelly was saying, yeah, we'll take Giannis off your hands for Julius Randle in the first round pick.

text_blocks.speaker: Jim Souhan
text_blocks.text: If I were to handicap all of the possibilities out there, I do think that Giannis is a really hard one to pull off.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Trade rumors surrounding Kawhi Leonard and Jalen Suggs
quotes.excerpt: You are hearing Kawhi Leonard, you are hearing maybe a little bit of Jalen Suggs.

text_blocks.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
text_blocks.text: You are hearing Kawhi Leonard, you are hearing maybe a little bit of Jalen Suggs, a few other names. A lot of what is going on right now, I think is just sort of fact finding, a little bit of due diligence to see what is achievable and what isn't.

text_blocks.speaker: Jim Souhan
text_blocks.text: Once these finals are over, then you will see them kind of go into, all right, let's really kind of target a couple of guys and see what we can pull off.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating the feasibility of a Kawhi Leonard trade
quotes.excerpt: Kawhi Leonard is a really hard one to pull off. I think Kyrie Irving is a more realistic possibility.

text_blocks.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
text_blocks.text: If I were to handicap all of the possibilities out there, I do think that Kawhi Leonard is a really hard one to pull off. I think Kyrie Irving is a more realistic possibility. You are hearing some other names start to just get kind of thrown around.

text_blocks.speaker: Jim Souhan
text_blocks.text: Kawhi Leonard has been a great player, man, I just don't think he can take that risk, do you?

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Assessing the risks of trading for Kawhi Leonard
quotes.excerpt: Kawhi Leonard is coming off of injuries, is getting a little older, but I'm not worried about any of his health issues actually.

text_blocks.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
text_blocks.text: Kawhi Leonard is coming off of injuries, is getting a little older, but I'm not worried about any of his health issues actually. I'm just concerned about the price you'd have to pay to get him. Every one that you would go after is going to have some sort of warts you got to figure out.

text_blocks.speaker: Jim Souhan
text_blocks.text: There are just so many things you'd have to look at with bringing Kawhi Leonard in that, yeah, I would be reticent to do it.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Davis as a potential, albeit risky, trade target
quotes.excerpt: I think Anthony Davis, if I were the Timberwolves, I'd look at him a little bit.

text_blocks.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
text_blocks.text: I think Anthony Davis, if I were the Timberwolves, I'd look at him a little bit. Is this a possibility to maybe buy a little lower on an extremely talented guy? But guess what, he's got injury issues and things that you'd have to deal with.

text_blocks.speaker: Jim Souhan
text_blocks.text: Kawhi is coming off of injuries, is getting a little older, but I'm not worried about any of his health issues actually. I'm just concerned about the price you'd have to pay to get him.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant as a high-risk, high-reward trade target
quotes.excerpt: Ja Morant is another one. If all other things don't go well for the Wolves this off season.

text_blocks.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
text_blocks.text: Ja Morant is another one. If all other things don't go well for the Wolves this off season and they don't get, you know, maybe one of their top priorities, is could I see them circling back and saying, well, let's go see if you can buy low on Ja Morant? Yeah, maybe.

text_blocks.speaker: Jim Souhan
text_blocks.text: Then you have to deal with all of his stuff that comes in. So, all of these things are dice rolls.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Zion Williamson's trade viability and health concerns
quotes.excerpt: I've seen somebody float Zion Williamson. To me, I don't know if he's a fit.

text_blocks.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
text_blocks.text: I've seen somebody float Zion Williamson. To me, I don't know if he's a fit, I don't know if I trust his health, I don't know. What do you think about that possibility?

text_blocks.speaker: Jim Souhan
text_blocks.text: So with Zion, Jace Frederick from the Pioneer Press brings him up a lot to his credit, but and and but and one of the reasons is because every time Zion Williamson plays the Timberwolves, he absolutely kicks their ass.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Trading for Zion Williamson requires careful roster consideration
quotes.excerpt: If you move Julius Randle for Zion, and you put him next to Rudy Gobert and Jaden McDaniels.

text_blocks.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
text_blocks.text: If you move Julius Randle for Zion, and you put him next to Rudy Gobert and Jaden McDaniels, then you would say, hey, any sort of defensive concerns that we have about Zion Williamson are mitigated because of the guys that we have around him.

text_blocks.speaker: Jim Souhan
text_blocks.text: And if you could get him into a change of scenery where he kind of grows up a little bit from a maturity standpoint and and and he's able to stay healthy.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Pelicans' resource constraints and Zion Williamson's future
quotes.excerpt: The New Orleans Pelicans who I think don't have a whole lot of resources at their disposal.

text_blocks.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
text_blocks.text: Can we sort of tap into something from a health perspective that the New Orleans Pelicans who I think don't have a whole lot of resources at their disposal, weren't able to do? That's a possibility.

text_blocks.speaker: Jim Souhan
text_blocks.text: If you could get him healthy and get him focused, he is an incredible talent.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Terry's influence and connection to the Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: We got to get Steve Terry back on the show here soon.

text_blocks.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
text_blocks.text: We got to get Steve Terry back on the show here soon. We haven't talked to him in a little while and I'm really interested in his take on all this, because not only is he a super fan, he also has the connections in the organization.

text_blocks.speaker: Jim Souhan
text_blocks.text: Sometimes he tells us stuff.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Chu Vision Institute's role in vision correction
quotes.excerpt: I had Lasik surgery with Chu Vision about two years ago now, and it's been just an incredible thing.

text_blocks.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
text_blocks.text: Chu Vision Institute in Bloomington, go to chuvision.com to set up your free consultation. I had Lasik surgery with Chu Vision about two years ago now, and it's been just an incredible thing for my life.

text_blocks.speaker: Jim Souhan
text_blocks.text: I don't have to deal with the hassles of glasses and contacts anymore.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves' resilience in remaining competitive despite roster changes
quotes.excerpt: Olivia Miles is an unbelievable talent that comes in and is just changing everything around there.

text_blocks.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
text_blocks.text: Olivia Miles is an unbelievable talent that comes in and is just changing everything around there, or at least keeping them afloat, and Cheryl Reeve just keeps on figuring out ways and finding ways to stay relevant and not fall back to the pack.

text_blocks.speaker: Jim Souhan
text_blocks.text: It is incredible what they are doing over there.
